messages:
Maya (Product): FYI — ACME SI + TitanHW asked for our SOC2 report, latest pen test exec summary, and a cleaned artifact bundle for the marketplace listing. Need to confirm timelines and redaction rules.
Samir (SecOps): Copy. We can provide SOC2 type II PDF and the pen test executive summary. For the artifact bundle, what exactly do they need? full logs or sanitized configs? :thinking_face:
Jess (Partner Eng): They requested "evidence bundle" per marketplace spec: SOC, pen report (redacted), vulnerability scan output, and an attachments index mapping owners. Also a short onboarding Q&A filled by the SI. They said artifacts must be presigned and TTLed.
Oliver (Solutions): For TitanHW we also have to include firmware attestation notes and an HSM attestation statement — that may need a separate uploader from their side. Can legal sign off on the wording for attestations?
Liam (Legal): I can review the attestation template. Heads up: we need to avoid exposing customer PII or contract snippets. Redaction checklist: remove customer names, IP addresses, exact internal IP ranges, and any raw logs with PII. We can use a standard statement: "no customer identifiable data included".
Samir (SecOps): Proposed artifact workflow: 1) Create temporary evidence S3 prefix, 2) Upload redacted artifacts, 3) Run a scrub script that replaces UUIDs + IPs, 4) Generate MD5 manifest, 5) Presign links for partner for 72h. I can own the scrub script.
Maya (Product): Timeline constraint — ACME SI wants artifacts by EOD next Wednesday so they can finish listing checks before their end-of-month launch. Is 72h presign enough?
Jess (Partner Eng): 72h is fine for the initial handoff. If we need more time we can issue rolling presigns. Also, marketplace has a separate ingestion process — they prefer a zip with a top-level index.json describing each artifact and contact.
Oliver (Solutions): Can we include a small README with intent and who to contact for follow-ups? that avoids back-and-forth later.
Samir (SecOps): Agreed. I'll add README.md with the scrub steps and redaction notes. Example scrub rule snippet:
```
# scrub_rules.conf
redact: ["email", "ip", "aws_account_id"]
replace_with: "<REDACTED>"
```
I'll post the script after a dry run.
CI Bot: Build #4821: evidence-bundle-generator passed. artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/temp/1734567890/ (presigned links pending) :white_check_mark:
Samir (SecOps): Quick note: pen-test vendor requires consent for sharing full technical appendix. We have the exec summary cleared; the full appendix contains exploitation details — legal needs to approve before we include it.
Liam (Legal): Do not share the full technical appendix unless the partner has an NDA or specific contract clause. For marketplace public bundles, only summaries. For TitanHW SI we can share full appendix under a signed MSA addendum; ask them to confirm.
Maya (Product): Action items: Samir to scrub + prepare bundle (owner), Liam to draft short attestation + confirm appendix policy (owner), Jess to coordinate partner ingestion window and presign request (owner), Oliver to prepare README and firmware attestation note (owner). Target delivery: 2024-08-21 17:00 PST (EOD Wed).
Jess (Partner Eng): I'll ping ACME SI legal and ops to request MSA addendum if they want the appendix. Also confirming they accept a 72h presign TTL.
Samir (SecOps): Will run scrub tomorrow morning and post the checklist + manifest here. Planning to presign links on Tuesday evening so they have time to validate.
Liam (Legal): Drafting attestation language now, will post by EOD today for quick review.
Maya (Product): Great — small ask: when you presign, include expiry timestamp in the README and a contact for re-issuance.
Oliver (Solutions): Noted. Also, let's avoid embedding raw firmware binaries in the initial bundle — provide checksums and a controlled download via partner portal. Keeps the bundle lightweight.
Jess (Partner Eng): Partner update I just got: ACME SI wants a short blurb we can co-publish announcing joint marketplace availability once compliance is verified. Will need legal approval on wording and a go/no-go signoff date.
Liam (Legal): For announcement copy, we'll need to avoid implying any independent security endorsement. Suggested phrase: "Redwood is a validated integration partner; compliance artifacts provided for listing verification." I'll draft suggested copy.
Maya (Product): Ok — let's reconvene Thursday 9am to confirm all artifacts and announcement copy. If everything lands by Wed EOD we'll hit the partner's timeline. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
